group: Combat actions, blocked hits and damaging hits
processing: Independent recorded takes; trim, stereo fold-down, 48kHz resample, DC removal, edge fades and peak gain only. No synthesis, pitch shifting or artificial extra variants. Glass Foley represents ice; cloth and soft Foley represent foliage; Seax air swishes represent sling release; compressed-air recording represents blowpipe release.

sources.title: Medieval sound effects - Weapon Textures
sources.author: Ben Jaszczak and Brian Nelson / Still North Media

hardnessMatrix.notes: Three acoustic hardness levels; independent directional source/target pairs. Soft Foley and wood dominate low contacts; plate/punch for medium; glass/mining/metal for harder contacts. Explicit special cues remain separate.
